portrait_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game character cutout for a cozy 2D pixel-art witch town, transparent RGBA, portrait canvas 2:3. Primary request: design ONE original friendly female guide NPC called Yingluo, the town's moon-lantern keeper and journal courier. Full body in a front-facing relaxed standing pose, feet at same baseline, entire hat and lantern visible with generous transparent margins. A small adult chibi witch, warm kind face, short ash-lavender bob with a little leaf-shaped gold clip, a softly bent dark moss-green witch hat with a cream band and tiny crescent pin, sage-green travel cape over a cream blouse and aubergine skirt, warm brown ankle boots. Holds a small glowing amber moon lantern at her right side (viewer left), and a closed burgundy journal tucked under her other arm. Clear charming silhouette, recognizable at 32x48 game size. Style: restrained cozy storybook PIXEL ART, crisp square pixel clusters, purple-brown outlines, cream highlights, low-saturation natural colors, chunky simplified features, approximately 64x96 logical pixel art displayed enlarged with hard nearest-neighbor edges. No airbrush or smooth gradients; no realistic rendering. Lighting: warm gentle lantern light but NO external glow cloud: transparent outside solid character and lantern. Composition: centered single full-body character occupying 85 percent canvas height, no environment, no ground plane, no drop shadow, no text, no labels, no watermark, no other objects or characters. Genuine transparent background. Final file will be copied into Art/Characters/Yingluo/yingluo.png, never MyArt.
world_sprite_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the provided full-body Yingluo witch image. Convert this SAME character into an extremely simple authentic low-resolution RPG world sprite. One front-facing full-body standing sprite only, exact same identity: bent moss-green witch hat with cream band and crescent brooch, lavender bob, sage cape, cream sleeves, plum skirt, brown boots, amber moon lantern on viewer left, burgundy journal on viewer right. Crucial: target logical resolution is only 32 pixels wide by 48 pixels tall, show the tiny sprite scaled up as uniform large crisp square pixel blocks. Every feature must be represented by very few big solid color pixel clusters; face has two simple 1-pixel eyes, one-pixel mouth. The hat and cape need broad shapes, not tiny detailed texture. 16-24 flat opaque colors, 1 logical pixel dark purple-brown outline, simple three-tone shading, no gradients, no smooth edges, no painterly detail, no grid lines. Fixed straight front-facing feet, short adult chibi proportions. Genuine fully transparent background outside sprite, preserve solid alpha on character itself. Do NOT render any background, glow halo, floor, drop shadow, border, text or second character. Full body with a small transparent margin. The purpose is a production in-world sprite to sit beside existing 32x48 pixel art NPCs; silhouette at tiny size is much more important than illustration detail. Do not put both original and new version in the image.
